acceptance: #4322's diff no longer touches the watchdog tests.
Its changelog and body describe only its own changes.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
The atomic PID-file publish reached develop in #4311. #4322 still adds `recorded_pid` in tests/unit/utils/test_heavy_watchdog.py, whose empty-file branch cannot be reached, plus a test of that helper, and its body and changelog claim a test race fix it does not contain. #4322 also conflicts with develop in tests/system/test_ci_lint_parity.py.

## Change
Remove the helper and its test, restore the direct read, correct the changelog fragment and the pull request body, and merge develop.

## Decision gates
None.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `git diff origin/develop...HEAD -- tests/unit/utils/` shows no change; the changelog and body name only what the diff contains; the branch merges cleanly.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
